Accumulation zone.subject: World Geography
Accumulation zone.question: The _____ was Area on a glacier.

Afromontane.question: The _____ was Subregion of the Afrotropical realm.
Afromontane.fact: The Afromontane regions are subregions of the Afrotropical realm, one of the Earth's eight biogeographic realms, covering the plant and animal species found in the mountains of Africa and the southern Arabian Peninsula.
